featured_reviews.name: Zainab Dayatar
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm an Andheri based cat feeder. Arham ambulance has recently helped me treat 3 of my strays. Their ambulance arrives within minutes. Dr is good. U can avail their services when an animal is in urgent need. They don't charge a penny. The 2 problems I found were firstly hygiene. The table was not cleared before treating the next patient. Thank you AYSG for helping us help the strays.

featured_reviews.review_text: Humanity Global Foundation is an NGO that began its journey during the COVID-19 pandemic with a clear focus on social welfare and community support. featured_reviews.name: Dhanlaxmi Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Humanity Global Foundation is a shining example of kindness in action.  Their dedication to education for underprivileged children, disaster relief, sustainability, tree plantation, beach cleanups, and support for orphanages and old age homes is truly commendable.

They work selflessly to uplift lives and protect our planet. Every contribution to this foundation helps bring hope and change where it’s needed most. Let’s support and stand with them in their beautiful mission to serve humanity!

featured_reviews.review_text:

I really appreciate their commitment to humanitarian values and the way they create real impact on the ground. They not only provide immediate support but also work towards long-term sustainable solutions, empowering people to build better lives.
Highly recommend supporting their initiatives — every effort here goes a long way in making the world a better place. 🙏❤️

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very positive experience with HGF NGO Job Cell. Their team is professional, supportive, and truly dedicated to connecting candidates with the right opportunities in the NGO and development sector. The process was smooth and transparent, and I really appreciate the guidance they provided at every stage.

They not only share relevant job openings but also ensure that the roles align with one’s skills and interests. What makes them stand out is their quick response, personal attention, and genuine effort to help job seekers. It feels reassuring to know that there’s an organization committed to bridging the gap between NGOs and passionate professionals who want to make a difference.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to build a meaningful career in the social sector. 👍

महाराष्ट्र राज्य हे देशात असे एकमेव राज्य आहे जिथे एवढ्या मोठ्या संख्येत गडकिल्ले आहेत. राज्याच्या कोपऱ्या - कोपऱ्यात गडकिल्ले विखुरलेले आहेत आणि त्यांचा स्वतंत्र असा एक इतिहास आहे. आपल्या मराठी ऐतिहासिक संस्कृतीचे प्रतिक म्हणून या गडकिल्ल्यांना अनन्यसाधारण महत्व आहे पण ह्याच गडकिल्ल्यावर वाढलेले गवत-काटेरी झुडूप, पडलेल्या भिंती, ढासळत असलेले बुरुज, छप्पर नसलेली मंदिरे, दुर्गंधी सुटलेली तलावातील पाणी अक्षरशः कचराकुंडी झालेली आहे. ह्या सगळ्या गोष्टी लक्षात घेऊन एक सामाजिक बांधिलकी आणि शिवविचार पेटता राहण्यासाठी "शिवदुर्ग प्रतिष्ठाण - दुर्गसंवर्धन हाच एक ध्यास" ह्या संस्थेची स्थापना करण्यात आली आहे.
शिवदुर्ग प्रतिष्ठाण हे ठाणे जिल्ह्यातील शहापूर तालुक्यात आसनगाव येथील माहुली गडावर १९ फेब्रुवारी २०१७ पासून गडस्वच्छतेचे कार्य करीत आहे.

name: Sparsha Charitable Trust
description:
Introduction to Sparsha Charitable Trust
In many parts of Mumbai, children from underprivileged families face significant vulnerabilities. These children often lack access to proper care, protection, and nurturing environments, which impedes their ability to reach their highest potential. Factors such as economic hardship, lack of educational opportunities, and inadequate health care further exacerbate their struggles. Recognizing these critical challenges, Sparsha Charitable Trust is committed to unfolding the potential of these children through comprehensive family support and the creation of sustainable communities.

featured_reviews.name: Christopher Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a shelter home for children from difficult backgrounds, particularly orphans, runaway boys and street boys. The institution is under the care of the Salesians of Don Bosco (priests and brothers) who reside there and nurture the kids 24*7. There are many volunteers particularly from colleges nearby who volunteer to teach the young boys and train them with skills needed for being successful in their future. There are staff members and the priests and brothers who are always with the kids and the top priority is education of the kids. The institution was established in the year 1987 and from then has many success stories and repatriation stories to the credit of this institution. It is a registered home for children in need of care and protection and is also periodically assessed to function efficiently. You can contribute in kind or can go there and help them as per their present requirements. It's a blessing and an heart touching experience to spend time with these kids, express our love for them and care for them, They haven't got it enough. WELCOME to Shelter Don Bosco. Moreover pray for this institution and everyone there. The boys are in the age group of 10-18 yrs of age.

featured_reviews.name: THE TEAM
featured_reviews.review_text: There are around 70 boys of differet age. People come to share their birthday's, death anniversary etc with this kids. We need to infrom 1 day prior if breakfast or meal if we are providing meal. The father is very helpful.  The childrens get very happy after seein someone coming to meet them. They accept clothes and food donation.
